tools.name: search_facilities
tools.description: Search nursing facilities by name, geography, or distance from a free-form address. Defaults to the latest CMS monthly snapshot; pass filedate from list_file_dates to query a prior month.

tools.name: get_facility
tools.description: Get one facility by provnum or web slug. Defaults to the latest CMS monthly snapshot; pass filedate from list_file_dates to query a prior month.

tools.name: get_facility_ownership
tools.description: Get ownership records for one facility. Defaults to the latest CMS monthly snapshot; pass filedate from list_file_dates to query a prior month.

tools.name: search_owners
tools.description: Search owners by name. Defaults to the latest CMS monthly snapshot; pass filedate from list_file_dates to query a prior month.

tools.name: get_owner
tools.description: Get owner portfolio by web_owner slug. Defaults to the latest CMS monthly snapshot; pass filedate from list_file_dates to query a prior month.

tools.name: list_file_dates
tools.description: List CMS monthly snapshot dates available in the database (newest first), plus the current filedate and known unpublished months. Use a returned date as filedate on other tools to retrieve a prior month instead of the latest data.

tools.name: get_data_freshness
tools.description: Get latest source dataset dates and row counts. For prior months, call list_file_dates and pass filedate to other tools.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_facilities" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

Defaults to the latest CMS monthly snapshot; pass filedate from list_file_dates to query a prior month."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
